title: Model call
description: ODIN's MODEL_CALL record, one per API call, submitted to POST /log/agent (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §8.3, §11, §16.5 U17). A turn that uses a tool makes several. Every field is always present, null when its subject does not exist (§16 U15): no token counts the provider did not return, no latency or usage for a call the meter stopped.

call_index.description: Which API call of the turn this is, counting from 1 as turn_id and record_id do (the Director's ruling on U20, 26 October 2026).

provider.description: The provider, as the run's configuration names it.

model_id.description: The model ID sent to the provider, exactly.

reasoning_effort.description: The reasoning setting sent with the call, explicitly, never the provider's default (§11.1).

max_output_tokens.description: The call's maximum output, reasoning included (§11.3).

output_tokens.description: Output tokens, reasoning included, as both providers bill it (§11.2).

reserved_cost_usd.description: The worst-case cost reserved before the call (§11.3).

actual_cost_usd.description: The cost from actual usage, which replaces the reservation.

pays_from.description: Which of the meter's four amounts the call draws on (§11.2).

provider_usage.description: The provider's usage block exactly as returned, so the meter's figures can later be checked against the provider's bill.
